date.as_written: śrīsaṃvat 1872 sāla miti caitra vadi 10 śanau

notes: The era is not named, but 'saṃvat ... sāla miti' is the Nepali VS formula, and it agrees with the catalogue (SAM 1872). VS 1872 gives 1815 CE. However, Caitra vadi falls at the start of VS 1872 under pūrṇimānta reckoning (March 1815) but at the end of it under amānta reckoning (March/April 1816). The scribe's name is written 'sivākāṃta' with s for ś, normalised to Śivakānta. 'jyotirvidaṃ' is probably a corrupt instrumental (jyotirvidā), 'by the astrologer', so jyotirvid is taken as his title or profession. The colophon calls the text 'vaidyajivanaṭīkā', a commentary, ascribed to Lolimbarāja. Lolimbarāja wrote the root text Vaidyajīvana; the commentator is not named.
